names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Ευλάμπιος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 5 марта ст. ст., name page 682, «Евлампий Палестинский, мч.», with the rank and grade words left off. The day's own line declines the name. **The index gives him a toponymic the day's line does not and the corpus did not hold**: the line is the bare «Мч. Евлампия .» and this folder's display name disambiguates by the day, having nothing else; the index says Палестинский, which the life repeats. The toponymic is what keeps this form out of the fold: `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports the bare «Евлампий» held by `eulampius-of-nicomedia`, and no folder at all holding «Евлампий Палестинский».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 марта ст. ст. — «Мч. Евлампия»

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Ευλάμπιος»

attestations.note: The page gives him one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Ευλάμπιος μαρτύρησε στην Παλαιστίνη διά ξίφους» — he was martyred in Palestine by the sword. It prints the distich «Τράχηλον Εὐλάμπιος ἐκτμηθεὶς ξίφει, / Τραχηλιῶσαν δυσσέβειαν αἰσχύνει», and gives no year, no emperor, no judge, no relic and no hymn. The corpus keeps a Eulampius of Nicomedia, martyred with his sister Eulampia and kept on another day, and he is not this man.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
